section: Accidental Deaths and Suicides in India 1996
title: ACCIDENTAL DEATHS & SUICIDES IN INDIA - 1996 N.C.R.B.(M.H.A.) 3.3.2 Among the specified causes of suicides, illness and family problem to be the major causes in commission of suicides at All-India level as in the previous year (1995). During 1996, however, higher number of suicides, compared to figures of 1995, were committed due to Suspected illicit relation, cancellation or non-settlement of marriage, not having children, illness due to AIDS/STD, Cancer, paralysis, insanity/mental illness, divorce, drug abuse, family problems, illegitimate pregnancy, physical abuse, poverty and career problem.
